row.evidence: Domino's docs describe SAML 2.0/OIDC SSO through Keycloak with users created on first sign-in, LDAP/AD federation and manual Admin-panel user creation; no SCIM endpoint is documented in any docs version, and all plans are quote-only.
row.notes: No SCIM found by absence: searched the pricing page and datasheet, the full docs sitemap (all versions 3.6 to 6.2), the Platform API reference and the admin user-management pages. Automation is JIT on SAML/OIDC sign-in via Keycloak, plus Keycloak LDAP/AD federation; SAML attributes can sync Domino organization membership and admin roles at sign-in. Plans (Domino Cloud, Premium, Enterprise) are all quote-only. The Okta catalogue app is SWA only. The Platform API can list users and add/remove users from organizations but has no create/deactivate user endpoint.

plans.name: Domino Cloud
plans.notes: Single-tenant SaaS; 5 service accounts, 5 admin licenses, unlimited consumer licenses.

scim.notes: available left null (absence): no SCIM page or mention in any version of the docs sitemap; the vendor never says no explicitly.

capabilities.notes: create_user false = no such endpoint in the Platform API reference; user creation is via Admin panel or SSO sign-in. manage_groups = Domino organizations.

limitations.text: The user API key feature is marked for deprecation in future Domino versions.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Dec. 25 2015) has only SWA checked in the page markup; SAML, OIDC, SCIM and provisioning actions are unchecked.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (domino-tutorial and domino-data-lab-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Keycloak LDAP/AD user federation; SAML attribute sync of Domino organizations and admin roles at sign-in
